title: Play can now make audio and keep its outputs around
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: audio arrived in Play, account tooling got clearer, and the API learned to report trouble more honestly.

The Play experience gained audio generation, a cleaner login UI, and more reliable output persistence. Login also now preselects profile and balance permissions, reducing the amount of permission archaeology required to get started.

Account endpoint response schemas are now documented, the dashboard shows a service-availability KPI, and usage-data CSV downloads work again. Slightly fewer mysteries hiding behind a button labeled export.

The gen.pollinations.ai proxy was simplified, while image requests through Azure now return the correct upstream error status codes. APIs should fail with less interpretive dance when something goes wrong.
